data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 68.5m (2014: GBP 83.1m) is an improvement of GBP 9.0m (2014: improvement of GBP 6.4m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to beneficial developments in prior year reserves across the Marine and Transport classes.
data.standardized_narrative: Gross prior-year claims reserves reduced by approximately GBP 4.91m (a ~2.18% release relative to opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 224.78m). This release arises from favourable development across older underwriting years (notably 2011-2013), principally in the Marine/Transport related classes, reflecting a generally benign catastrophe season, lower-than-expected attritional and large loss activity and resolution of certain legacy issues.
raw_causal_phrases: beneficial developments of GBP 9.0m in prior year reserves
beneficial developments in prior year reserves across the Marine and Transport classes
benefitting from a generally benign catastrophe season
lower than expected attritional and large loss activity
the resolution of certain legacy issues

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to Property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) computed from the gross claims development triangle (note 22). Opening gross claims outstanding taken from balance sheet comparative column. The report also references a net improvement of GBP 9.0m in prior-year reserves within net claims incurred (this is a net figure and not the gross PYD used here). Triangle values are reported in GBP '000; PYD converted to millions for this output. Confidence flagged as calculated (0.8). No Reinsurance-to-Close distortions were identified in the notes.
